title: decision-provenance-row
description: One decision-provenance row appended per turn by the EXISTING per-turn pipeline (placement engine, authority schema, routing hooks). Source of shape: holding/plans/native-sop-program/v1-build/SCOPE.md section 4 (B18-1, amended by the S0 gate review). Fields the pipeline cannot honestly compute in a given turn carry not_evaluated/null. Evolution is additive-only; writes are atomic (temp+rename).

schema_version.description: Row-shape version carried by every row (SCOPE section 4 preamble).

turn_id.description: Identifier of the turn this decision row belongs to.

decision_seq.description: Sequence number of this decision within the turn.

operator_id.description: Operator whose turn produced the decision.

charter_ref.description: Charter reference; null when the pipeline cannot honestly compute it this turn (writer note).

domain_ref.description: Domain reference; null when not honestly computable this turn (writer note).

task_tier.description: Task tier as computed by the existing pipeline; null when not honestly computable this turn (writer note).

phase.description: Phase of the unit at decision time; null when not honestly computable this turn (writer note).

intent_type.description: Classified intent type from the per-turn pipeline; null when not honestly computable this turn (writer note).

factors.description: Factors the pipeline observed for this decision.

source_ref.description: Where the factor value came from; null when not honestly attributable this turn (writer note).

authority_verdict.description: Authority outcome; not_evaluated when the pipeline did not evaluate authority this turn (writer note).

reversibility.description: Reversibility as computed by the existing pipeline; null when not honestly computable this turn (writer note). SCOPE section 4 does not ratify an enum for this field, so it is deliberately left as a free string.

approval_ref.description: Reference to the approval artifact; explicitly nullable in SCOPE section 4.

work_ref.description: Reference to the unit of work (e.g. workflow id); null when not honestly computable this turn (writer note).

output_ref.description: Reference to the produced output artifact; null when not honestly computable this turn (writer note).
